overreach: Wi‑Fi 8 builds on Wi‑Fi 7 with UHR-focused features
R&D or production-oriented RF waveform verification beyond Wi‑Fi 7 requirements
review.reason: The core workflow placement is well supported: CMX500 signaling testing is described for Wi‑Fi 7 R&D under signaling/real-world conditions, while CMP180 non-signaling RF testing is described for WLAN production to save time. Some Wi‑Fi 8 framing goes beyond the passages, especially PHY/MAC validation, UHR-focused wording, and positioning CMP180 waveform verification as an R&D workflow step, but these are secondary to the main answer.
